name: Parameterized Example Queries
description: Query Templates are parameterized example queries for SQL databases and Semantic Models that teach Data Agents how to answer common business questions. By providing trusted query patterns with reusable parameters, Query Templates help agents generate more accurate and efficient queries, reducing ambiguity and improving consistency. Templates can be created manually, generated with AI, or built through a guided skill experience. By leveraging optimized query patterns, Data Agents can deliver faster responses, higher answer accuracy, and more reliable results while reducing the need for complex prompt engineering and extensive agent instructions.

result.descriptionEs: Las Query Templates son consultas de ejemplo parametrizadas para SQL databases y semantic models que enseñan a los Data Agents a responder preguntas de negocio frecuentes. Con patrones de consulta fiables y parámetros reutilizables, los agentes generan consultas más precisas y eficientes. Las plantillas pueden crearse a mano, con IA o mediante una experiencia guiada, y reducen la necesidad de prompts complejos.
